versions.changelog:
1.0.1: Bump to dodge ClawHub version conflict on initial submit.

- No functional changes—version increment only.
- Ensures compatibility and avoids version collision during initial ClawHub publication.
- Previous content and orchestration logic remain unchanged.

- Initial release of the LGD Governance Method Suite.
- Provides a bilingual (English & Chinese) playbook for the full AI agent governance lifecycle.
- Orchestrates 9 independently published sub-skills by slug; does not include sub-skill internals.
- Includes documentation and a read-only CLI routing tool for governance, security audits, and release compliance checks.
- Designed for users seeking an end-to-end governance plan, security audit procedure, or release compliance review.
